materials_exhausted.note: Local supplementary .bin assets were checked and resolve to duplicated article HTML landing pages, not data tables; source-supported values needed for worker-2/4/6 gate repair were recoverable from XML/PDF/figures and merged database rows.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: APD6 AP03332 and DBAASP DBAASPR_19002 sequence/catalog rows match the primary Yodha sequence. Linked DBAASP assay rows for ZIKV, DENV1-4, RBC hemolysis, and LDH cytotoxicity now have primary XML/PDF/figure locators and matched activity record IDs.

Figure-only exact mutant/variant bar heights are retained as nonblocking caution instead of fabricated numeric rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Direct mechanism is limited to ZIKV particle disruption by TEM and entry-competence loss by qRT-PCR/IF; hydrophobic N-terminus/bilayer targeting remains indirect inference with explicit limitation.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: The original ticket is closed after source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 repair because blocking missing-activity, database-conflict, and generic worker-6 review failures were resolved. Remaining gaps are caution-only and do not require another queue attempt.

caution_findings.evidence_context: The source supports main IC50/toxicity values and qualitative mutant/variant conclusions, but exact per-bar values for all figure-only panels are not tabulated locally.
All ten local supplementary .bin assets resolve as article HTML landing pages; no spreadsheet/office/PDF supplement table was recoverable from those paths.
Primary evidence supports virion disruption and entry loss, but not the exact viral molecular binding site.
